posterA4.label: A4 poster
posterA4.description: On a wall or at the entrance
posterA4.howTo: Print on A4, borderless if your printer can.

posterA5.label: A5 poster
posterA5.description: On the counter, in a frame or stand
posterA5.howTo: Print on A5, or on A4 with “Fit to page”.

tent.label: Table tent
tent.description: Stands on its own at reception, visible from both sides
tent.howTo: Print on A4 (card is best), fold along the dotted line and stand it on the counter.

cards.label: Cards
cards.description: 8 on an A4 sheet, to hand to tourists
cards.howTo: Print on A4 and cut along the grey lines. Give one to each interested tourist.
